question: I am an active member returning hiking boots after 45 days of ordinary outdoor walking. This is my first fit-trial claim. I paid 120 dollars for the boots plus 6 dollars outbound delivery and will use one store return label. Am I eligible and how much comes back?

searches.query: I am an active member returning hiking boots after 45 days of ordinary outdoor walking. This is my first fit-trial claim. I paid 120 dollars for the boots plus 6 dollars outbound delivery and will use one store return label. Am I eligible and how much comes back?

chunks.text: This trial changes the eligibility window and acceptable wear for hiking boots only. It does not change the price of a return label. Read the return-label policy for the applicable fee and the membership policy for any shipping benefits. The fit trial does not promise a particular replacement model will be in stock.

Who pays for a return label  For ordinary domestic change-of-mind returns, the store offers a ground label for USD 7 per parcel. If the customer uses it, USD 7 is deducted from the refund or store credit. A customer may instead arrange and pay for their own suitable carrier. A store label covers one parcel; two parcels require two labels. Membership does not waive this fee.  An approved wrong-item shipment or manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid label without the USD 7 deduction. The support team must approve that reason first. A customer selecting a defect reason in the portal is not sufficient proof that the claim has been approved. The hiking boot fit trial is a fit return, so the normal USD 7 label fee applies unless the customer supplies their own shipping.  Use suitable packaging and keep the carrier acceptance receipt. Items containing an undamaged lithium battery must use the eligible ground service.

Hiking boot fit trial  Hiking boots bought from the online store have a 60-calendar-day fit trial, measured from delivery. This includes boots worn on ordinary outdoor walks. The purpose is to let customers discover pressure points that may not appear during an indoor fitting. The customer can claim one fit-trial return in any rolling 12-month period. Record the previous claim date before approving another pair.  The trial excludes damage from misuse, missing parts, and boots altered by a third party. Normal trail dust and wear from walking do not by themselves disqualify a pair. Remove loose dirt before packing. The boots must be returned as a complete pair. Boots that satisfy the trial receive a refund of the item price paid; original delivery charges remain nonrefundable.  Start the request in the normal returns portal and select the fit-trial reason. The standard seven-day dispatch deadline after approval still applies. This trial changes the eligibility window and acceptable wear for hiking boots only.

Standard returns for unused gear  The online store accepts ordinary unused gear within 30 calendar days after delivery. Customers must open a return request in the order portal before that window ends. After approval, they have seven calendar days to hand the parcel to the carrier. The request date determines whether the return was opened on time; the carrier acceptance date determines whether the shipping deadline was met.  Keep the original tags attached and include all parts. Trying a jacket on indoors does not count as using it. Washing a garment, taking a sleeping bag camping, or removing a safety seal does count as use. Used products cannot enter the ordinary change-of-mind return process. Hiking boots have a separate fit-trial policy, and damaged products have a separate warranty process. An exception for one product category does not extend the window for other products in the same order.  The warehouse checks the condition before approving the refund. A return request is not itself a refund.

A return request is not itself a refund. Customers receive a receipt after the inspection is complete. Original outbound delivery charges are not refunded for a change of mind. The return-label policy explains who pays for sending an item back. Do not send an item to the warehouse without an approved return request.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

The return-label fee follows the ordinary return-label policy. A recipient may use their own carrier if they do not want to buy the store label. This article does not describe the expiration date or transferability of store credit.

Reporting delivery damage or the wrong product  Report visible transport damage or a wrong product within seven calendar days after delivery. Keep the outer packaging and photograph the label, packing materials, and affected item. The support team compares those details with the shipment record before approving the claim. If the item is unsafe to use, stop using it while the report is assessed.  An approved wrong-product or delivery-damage return receives a prepaid label. The customer does not pay the ordinary USD 7 change-of-mind label fee for that approved return. The team confirms whether a replacement or another remedy will be provided. A report being opened does not prove replacement inventory exists or establish a delivery date for the replacement.  Damage involving a rechargeable battery follows the separate damaged-battery procedure. Do not put a leaking or swollen battery in an ordinary return parcel even when support is investigating delivery damage. A manufacturing defect discovered later follows the product's warranty process.

An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order. Import taxes and international return transport are covered in the international-orders article. Exchange approval does not automatically waive a return-label fee.

answer.answer: Yes, you are eligible. The hiking boot fit trial allows 60 calendar days from delivery for boots worn on ordinary outdoor walks, and this is your first claim in a 12-month period. You will receive a refund of the item price. Original outbound delivery charges are nonrefundable, and the store return label deducts USD 7. Calculation: USD 120 (item price) - USD 6 (outbound delivery, nonrefundable) - USD 7 (return label fee) = USD 107 refund.
